Description: Auction recovery schema v2: authenticated invitation-only demo, API, atomic Express workflows and durable notification outbox.

AllowedApiCidr.Description: 0.0.0.0/0 for the authenticated public demo; /32 for restricted staging.

Properties.FunctionCode: function handler(event) { var r=event.request; if (/^\/(?:users|auctions|help|callback)?\/?$/.test(r.uri) || /^\/bidding\/[^/]+\/?$/.test(r.uri)) r.uri='/index.html'; return r; }
